items.title: Tesla Bull Predicts Democrats Will “Block Autonomy,” a Bigger Risk Than Data Centers
items.summary: Key TakeawaysJason Calacanis, a Tesla shareholder, said on This Week in Startups that after the midterms Democrats will “block autonomy,” a bigger risk for tech than data centers. The risk is bigger for Tesla than for Alphabet’s Waymo, since Elon Musk says Cybercab will dominate only where the law allows it, and Tesla is moving Cybertruck out of Giga Texas to build more of them.
